nodes.title: Build the stock engine (the owned checkout at the base commit) for GB10 with CUDA - llama-server, llama-quantize and llama-imatrix - and smoke it on the tiny Muse NVFP4 test pack.
Write a precision recipe and requantize the tiny NVFP4 test pack to the mixed 2-bit format: routed gate and up experts to IQ2_XXS and down experts to Q2_K, everything else kept at its source type.
Record which experts the tiny 2-bit pack routes to on the calibration prompts (routing trace) and rank them into a seeded expert cache profile.
Run the paired accuracy recipe on the tiny test packs - NVFP4 as the reference arm, 2-bit as the candidate - to the first planned checkpoint.
Rehearsal end: held by the operator; the rehearsal does not send anything to the lab.
